verdict.rationale: AngelList claims customers can "move your cap table to Stack within minutes" but gives no detail on how the import works. It does document validation and reconciliation well: the Health Checks dashboard flags cap table inconsistencies, and the AI Tie Out Assistant finds mismatches between legal documents and cap table values. A support FAQ says customers are being moved to J.P. Morgan and Pulley, which suggests the product is being wound down and lowers confidence that inbound migration is still offered. Missing for 10: documentation of a guided import flow, spreadsheet import templates or field mapping, named import paths from other platforms (e.g. Carta), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration experience.
